name: bestfit-frequency
description: Evidence-backed flood frequency analysis with the local BestFit API.

interface.shortDescription: Research flood evidence and run BestFit FFA.
interface.longDescription: Collect and justify historical, regional and causal flood information, inspect input chronology and compare documented BestFit analysis candidates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use bestfit-frequency to investigate flood frequency at my requested location, justify inputs, show chronology and compare supported candidates.
